title: Order of Reagents
prompt: Add the reagents in the wrong order and the mixture is ruined. Operators have an order too.

rounds.explain: Multiplication happens before addition. 3 * 4 = 12 first, then + 2 = 14 — not 20.
Brackets go first, always. (2 + 3) = 5, then times 4 = 20. Parentheses let you force the order you want.
